TextWidget.Text: Representation follows this culture's institution. Party membership does not replace a member's individual vote.
Public seats and attendance are visible. Private agreements and personal opinions belong in individual conversations.
Recorded decisions preserve the ruler's recommendation separately from the government's result.
Authority changes alter how the ruler and government share decisions. They are separate from ordinary hearings.

LEVEL 1 · Advisory
The ruler decides after hearing the institution.

LEVEL 2 · Limited
Opposition carries formal political pressure.

LEVEL 3 · Substantial
Opposed decisions require reconsideration.

LEVEL 4 · Decisive
An override carries constitutional consequences.

LEVEL 5 · The assembly decides
The ruler recommends. Individual votes determine the binding result.
A reduction requires a separate consent vote. Failed consent does not silently force a reduction.
Introduce a policy, repeal, fief review, or expulsion. Every proposal follows the same hearing and voting rules.
